rule: Do not run these, feed their answers to the agent, or tune application logic to them during baseline diagnosis. Finalize their numerical oracles and hashes before any later improvement evaluation.

families.challenge: A suspended sign frame with independently editable hangers: shift the sign sideways while preserving its attachment points at the ceiling and keeping a neighboring light untouched.
families.difference: Inference through oblique links and changing orientations, not vertical floor-height dependencies.

families.challenge: A three-bay shelving unit with unequal bay widths: widen only the middle clear opening while maintaining outer shelf alignment, all shelf heights and panel thicknesses.
families.difference: Unequal internal constraints and topology-aware scope, not symmetric whole-object scaling.

families.challenge: A hollow elbow joining two offset ducts: relocate one port while retaining the other port, hollow continuity, wall thickness and a nearby independent support.
families.difference: Curved path adaptation with a protected endpoint, not merely changing primitive dimensions.
